propositions: MCP_HMAC_SIGNING_KEY environment variable and /rebar/prod/mcp-hmac-signing-key SSM parameter have a producer (Terraform declaration) and transport layer (user_data.sh, fetch-secrets.sh) but zero application consumers in runtime code, tests, or services

The documented purpose of MCP_HMAC_SIGNING_KEY (verdict signing) was superseded by ADR 0049, which replaced symmetric HMAC signing with asymmetric Ed25519 operation certificates; current verdict signing uses the opcert key, not any HMAC secret

Removal of the orphaned secret infrastructure requires atomic deletion across all three locations (terraform slot definition, user_data.sh PARAMS map, fetch-secrets.sh fetching and writing) to avoid boot-time failures from failed parameter lookups

Retention of MCP_HMAC_SIGNING_KEY imposes ongoing operator toil (provisioning, KMS storage, rotation of an unused secret) with zero security benefit and creates misleading audit signals that HMAC verdict signing remains active
